registry_snapshot.name: IS_PLAN
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses at least one intended future action or sequence of actions to be taken in service of the task.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended future action or plan.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies at least one operation or sequence of operations that the agent intends to perform later.
The intended action is presented as something to be done, not merely as a completed observation or factual statement.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports actions that have already been completed.
The reasoning states a fact or diagnosis without expressing any intended future action.

registry_snapshot.name: ACTION_IMPLEMENTS_PLANNED_STEP
registry_snapshot.definition: A recorded action carries out an operation that a reasoning node explicitly proposed as a future step, with matching task purpose rather than merely topical or temporal adjacency.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The recorded tool invocation that performs the step.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning node that proposes the future operation.

assertion_conditions: The plan_reasoning expresses an intended future operation or set of operations.
The action performs an operation consistent with the purpose and target of the proposed step.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only describes past or completed actions.
The action is unrelated to the proposed step or serves a different purpose.
The connection is based only on temporal adjacency without matching intent.

registry_snapshot.name: DIAGNOSES_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT_DEFECT
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning interprets content of an artifact exposed in an observation and identifies a specific missing, incomplete, or erroneous element that must be repaired.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies the artifact defect or incompleteness.

parameters.name: artifact_observation
parameters.description: The observation exposing the artifact content being diagnosed.

assertion_conditions: The observation exposes identifiable content of an artifact.
The reasoning identifies a specific defect, gap, or incomplete element in that artifact relative to the intended requirement.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats or paraphrases the artifact content without identifying a defect.
No specific missing, incomplete, or erroneous element is identified.
The observation does not expose artifact content relevant to the diagnosis.

registry_snapshot.name: PROPOSES_ARTIFACT_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning specifies a concrete correction or completion for an observed artifact defect, including replacement content or steps intended to make the artifact satisfy the requirement.

parameters.name: repair_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the proposed repair or completion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one concrete change, replacement, or added step intended to repair or complete an artifact.
The proposed repair is tied to an identified defect or requirement rather than being a generic intention to fix something.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only identifies a defect without proposing how to repair it.
The reasoning expresses only a generic intention to fix or improve without concrete content or steps.

registry_snapshot.name: CHECKS_ENVIRONMENT_PREREQUISITE
registry_snapshot.definition: An action probes the execution environment for the availability, identity, or version of a prerequisite tool or resource, and its observation reports capability evidence.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The diagnostic action that queries the environment or tool availability.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the presence, absence, identity, or version of the prerequisite.

assertion_conditions: The action is a diagnostic query about a prerequisite needed for the task.
The observation reports capability evidence such as presence, availability, identity, or version of the queried prerequisite.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs the primary task rather than checking a prerequisite.
The observation does not report any information about prerequisite capability or availability.

registry_snapshot.name: IMPLEMENTS_PROPOSED_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: An action applies the concrete correction specified in repair reasoning to the target artifact, and its result observation confirms that the modification was accepted.

parameters.name: repair_action
parameters.description: The action that writes or applies the proposed repair to the artifact.

parameters.name: repair_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the concrete correction or completion to be applied.

parameters.name: application_result
parameters.description: The observation confirming whether the artifact modification was accepted.

assertion_conditions: The repair_reasoning contains a concrete correction or completion for the artifact.
The repair_action applies content or changes corresponding to that proposed repair to the target artifact.
The application_result reports successful acceptance or modification of the artifact.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the proposed repair.
The content applied by the action does not correspond to the proposed correction.
The result reports failure or does not confirm acceptance of the modification.

registry_snapshot.name: PRODUCES_EXPECTED_BUILD_ARTIFACT
registry_snapshot.definition: An action invokes a build or compilation step on a source artifact, and its observation provides evidence that the expected derived artifact was generated.

parameters.name: build_action
parameters.description: The action that runs the build or compilation process.

parameters.name: build_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting generation of the expected derived artifact.

assertion_conditions: The action invokes a build, compilation, or equivalent transformation of a source artifact.
The observation provides evidence that the expected derived artifact was produced or exists after the build step.
exclusion_conditions: The action only inspects files without invoking a build or compilation step.
The observation does not show that the expected derived artifact was generated.
The build or compilation reports an error preventing artifact production.

registry_snapshot.name: DIAGNOSES_ACTION_FAILURE_FROM_ERROR
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning interprets an error or non-success result reported by an observation and identifies the cause or the condition that a corrected attempt must satisfy.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that interprets the failure and identifies its cause or required correction.

parameters.name: error_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the error or non-success result.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error, nonzero exit, or otherwise unsuccessful result from a prior action.
The reasoning identifies a cause, misunderstood condition, or requirement for a corrected attempt.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the error message without interpreting its cause or implications.
The reasoning retries the same operation without identifying any corrective condition.
The observation does not report an error or failure.

registry_snapshot.name: CORRECTS_FAILED_ACTION_WITH_DIAGNOSED_REVISION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent action revises an earlier failed operation in accordance with an explicit diagnosis of the failure, rather than repeating the same operation unchanged.

parameters.name: failed_action
parameters.description: The earlier action that produced the error result.

parameters.name: error_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the error from the failed action.

parameters.name: correction_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that diagnoses the failure and indicates the needed revision.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The subsequent action that implements the revised approach.

assertion_conditions: The failed_action is associated with an error_observation reporting failure.
The correction_reasoning identifies a cause or required change in approach.
The corrective_action changes a relevant parameter, command, or method to address the diagnosed failure while pursuing the same goal.
exclusion_conditions: The subsequent action repeats the failed action identically without revision.
The corrective action is unrelated to the diagnosed failure or targets a different goal.
No error observation or explicit diagnosis supports the revision.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_ARTIFACT_CONTENT_BY_INDEPENDENT_INSPECTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A targeted inspection or loading action retrieves the content of a produced artifact, and its observation exposes that content so the agent can confirm the artifact satisfies the intended property, not merely that it exists.

parameters.name: verification_intent_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning indicating the need or approach for checking artifact content.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action that loads or inspects the produced artifact's content.

parameters.name: inspection_result
parameters.description: The observation exposing the inspected artifact content or signature.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning indicates a verification goal concerning the artifact's content or meaning.
The inspection_action accesses or loads the produced artifact content rather than only checking file existence or metadata.
The inspection_result exposes content consistent with the intended property being verified.
exclusion_conditions: The check only confirms file existence, size, or other metadata without exposing content.
The observation output is unrelated to the intended property or is inconclusive.
The inspection action fails or does not retrieve the artifact content.

registry_snapshot.name: CONCLUDES_TASK_SUCCESS_FROM_ACCUMULATED_EVIDENCE
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning declares the task successfully completed and supports that declaration by referring to one or more observed verification outcomes rather than only restating the plan or action sequence.

parameters.name: conclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: The final reasoning that declares completion and cites verification evidence.

parameters.name: supporting_observations
parameters.description: The observations collectively supplying outcome evidence for the completion claim.

assertion_conditions: The conclusion_reasoning asserts that the task has been successfully completed.
The reasoning refers to or summarizes at least one observed outcome, such as a produced artifact or confirmed content.
The supporting_observations collectively contain verification evidence rather than only action acknowledgments or plans.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates plans or intermediate actions without asserting completion.
The success assertion is not supported by any observed outcome evidence.
The cited observations are unrelated to the claimed completion.

registry_snapshot.name: EVALUATES_ALTERNATIVES
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning contrasts two or more candidate approaches that could serve the same purpose and settles on one of them on the basis of an explicit comparative rationale.

parameters.name: deliberating_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that contrasts candidate approaches and justifies the selected one.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names at least two candidate approaches, tools, or configuration choices that could serve the same purpose.
The reasoning states a comparative rationale (robustness, availability, compatibility, convenience, simplicity) that favors the selected option over the alternative(s).
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes only a single approach without contrasting it against another.
The reasoning merely lists planned steps without weighing options against each other.
Another option is mentioned only in passing without any selection between the options being made.

registry_snapshot.name: IS_STATE_PROBE
registry_snapshot.definition: The action is a read-only inspection of system, environment, or artifact state carried out to obtain information, without altering that state.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action that inspects rather than modifies system or artifact state.

assertion_conditions: The action consists of informational query or inspection operations, such as listing directories or processes, reading or dumping configuration, or querying package, user, or service state.
The action's own description or command composition shows an informational purpose and contains no persistent modification of the inspected state.
exclusion_conditions: The action installs, creates, deletes, or reconfigures resources.
An inspection command appears only incidentally inside an action whose purpose is a persistent change.
The action executes a change and merely reports its own output.

registry_snapshot.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
registry_snapshot.definition: A targeted action is undertaken to discriminate a specific uncertainty or tentative assumption stated in reasoning about the environment, resources, tooling, data, or task requirements, and its observation supplies evidence bearing on that assumption.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted test or inspection.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the uncertainty or tentative assumption being tested.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content addresses the stated uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly formulates a specific uncertainty or tentative assumption whose truth would affect the result, procedure, or plan.
The action is chosen so that its result would distinguish between the assumption holding and not holding.
The observation contains content interpretable as evidence for or against the stated assumption.
exclusion_conditions: No identifiable assumption or uncertainty motivates the inspection.
The action inspects something unrelated to the stated assumption.
The observation does not address the assumption being tested.
The action merely repeats an earlier operation without any assumption being formulated.

registry_snapshot.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion about the system, environment, or task state using identifiable content of the observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: concluding_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that states the evidence-based conclusion.

parameters.name: evidential_observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying the content that supports the conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning asserts a conclusion about the state, capability, or composition of the environment or artifacts.
Specific content of the observation (reported items, absent items, versions, statuses, fetched output) supports that conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates or paraphrases the observation without drawing an inference from it.
The observation is unrelated to the stated conclusion or provides no identifiable support.

registry_snapshot.name: ADAPTS_PLAN_TO_OBSERVED_STATE
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning revises the intended course of action in response to a state revealed by the observation that departs from the assumptions of the earlier plan or that constrains the available options.

parameters.name: revised_plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that sets out the adjusted course of action.

parameters.name: state_revealing_observation
parameters.description: The observation that reveals the state prompting the adjustment.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a state that departs from the assumptions of the earlier course of action or removes options from it.
The reasoning explicitly derives a different set of subsequent steps as a consequence of that observed state.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning repeats the previous plan unchanged after the observation.
The reasoning records the observed state as a fact without altering what it intends to do next.
The adjustment is only a reaction to an error from an attempted action that is handled as failure diagnosis and correction.

registry_snapshot.name: MITIGATES_ANTICIPATED_FAILURE
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning anticipates a specific failure mode that could prevent successful completion, and the action implements a measure aimed at preventing or neutralizing that failure before it occurs.

parameters.name: safeguard_action
parameters.description: The action that implements the preventive measure.

parameters.name: risk_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that identifies the failure mode and motivates the safeguard.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a concrete failure mode or pitfall that could block the goal or invalidate the result.
The action contains a measure whose stated or evident purpose is to prevent or neutralize that specific failure mode.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning names no failure mode, so the measure cannot be tied to a risk.
The action is ordinary setup work with no identifiable correspondence to the described failure mode.
The safeguard is only proposed in reasoning and no corresponding action is performed.

registry_snapshot.name: CHECKS_VALIDITY_BEFORE_ACTIVATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The action validates a configuration artifact for correctness and activates or starts the corresponding service only after that validation succeeds, within one ordered guarded sequence.

parameters.name: guarded_action
parameters.description: The action that runs the validation check and the activation in a single guarded sequence.

assertion_conditions: The action invokes a syntax or integrity check on the configuration artifact that is about to be applied.
The activation or start of the service is sequenced after the check and is conditioned on the check succeeding.
exclusion_conditions: The action activates or starts the service without any preceding validation of the configuration.
A validation command is run in isolation long after the service was already activated.
The activation proceeds regardless of the validation outcome.

registry_snapshot.name: IMPLEMENTS_CONFIGURATION_AS_SPECIFIED
registry_snapshot.definition: An action applies concrete content or settings that a reasoning node specified as intended, writing or applying them to the relevant configuration or artifact, and the observation reports that the application succeeded.

parameters.name: configuration_action
parameters.description: The action that writes or applies the intended configuration content.

parameters.name: intent_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the intended settings, target, or configuration behavior.

parameters.name: application_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether the configuration was successfully written or applied.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies an intended setting, target, or configuration behavior to be put in place.
The action's content encodes settings or content corresponding to that stated intent, at a relevant path or scope.
The observation reports successful creation, writing, or application of that content.
exclusion_conditions: The action does not implement the settings described in the reasoning.
The observation reports failure, an error, or only an attempt without confirming the write or application.
The reasoning only discusses a configuration without stating an intended change.
The applied content is a correction of a defect already diagnosed in that same artifact, which is handled by repair-specific predicates.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR
registry_snapshot.definition: An action performs a check aimed at a specific behavior, output, or result that reasoning identified as expected, and the resulting observation reports an outcome matching that expectation, thereby confirming the behavior.

parameters.name: expectation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the expected behavior, output, or result.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action directed at exercising or observing the expected behavior.

parameters.name: result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the check.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a specific behavior, output, or result that is expected to occur.
The action is directed at exercising or observing that behavior or result.
The observation reports content consistent with the stated expectation, without contradiction.
exclusion_conditions: No expected behavior, output, or result is identifiable in the reasoning.
The action is unrelated to the expectation or only incidentally observes it.
The observation contradicts the expectation or is inconclusive about it.
The action only confirms existence, metadata, or an intermediate artifact state without addressing the expected behavior or result.

registry_snapshot.name: CLASSIFIES_FAILURE_AS_TEST_ARTIFACT
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning attributes an observed failure, anomaly, or misleading or empty result to the agent's own test setup, execution context, tooling, or measurement technique rather than to a defect in the target system being configured or built.

parameters.name: assessment_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning classifying the failure or anomalous result as induced by the agent's own testing, tooling, or measurement technique.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the failure, anomaly, or misleading or empty result.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a failure, error, anomaly, or empty or misleading result.
The reasoning attributes that result to the agent's own test setup, execution context, tooling, or measurement technique.
The reasoning distinguishes that cause from a genuine defect or limitation of the target system.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the failure as a genuine defect or limitation of the target system.
The reasoning only restates the failure or identifies a cause without classifying it as induced by the agent's own setup or measurement method.
The observation does not report a failure, anomaly, or misleading or empty result.

registry_snapshot.name: SUCCESSFUL_CORRECTIVE_RETRY
registry_snapshot.definition: After an operation is observed to fail and its cause is diagnosed, a subsequent action revises that operation in a manner addressing the diagnosed cause, and the resulting observation shows the operation succeeding or the prior failure no longer occurring.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the initial failed or blocked operation.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the cause of the failure and motivating the correction.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The revised action attempting the operation with a corrective change.

parameters.name: retry_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result of the retry.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation reports an unsuccessful or blocked operation.
The diagnosis reasoning identifies a specific cause of that failure.
The retry action differs from the failed operation in a manner that targets the diagnosed cause.
The retry observation reports success or the absence of the prior failure.
exclusion_conditions: The retry repeats the original operation without addressing the diagnosed cause.
No cause of the failure is diagnosed before the retry.
The retry observation still shows the same failure or provides no outcome evidence.

registry_snapshot.name: IS_STATE_AUDIT_PLAN
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning enumerates a set of distinct system, environment, or artifact state conditions to be confirmed before completion, forming a verification checklist whose items are observations to be checked rather than modifications to be made.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating the state conditions to be confirmed.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning lists two or more distinct conditions, artifacts, or behaviors to be checked in the current state.
The listed items are framed as things to confirm, inspect, or observe, not as actions that modify the system.
At least one item includes an anticipated value, acceptance criterion, or expected state against which a later observation can be compared.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes a single check without forming a multi-item verification set.
The reasoning lists only modification steps with no confirmation criteria.
The reasoning merely restates results already observed without enumerating conditions still to be confirmed.

registry_snapshot.name: AUDITS_PLANNED_CRITERIA
registry_snapshot.definition: An action gathers current state for the specific conditions enumerated in a prior verification plan, and its result reports values or artifacts for those conditions so that each planned criterion can be checked against the returned state.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning enumerating the criteria to be verified.

parameters.name: audit_action
parameters.description: The action that gathers the corresponding system state, possibly several checks in one invocation.

parameters.name: audit_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the values or artifacts for the planned criteria.

assertion_conditions: The plan_reasoning enumerates specific conditions to be confirmed.
The audit_action inspects the aspects of the system that correspond to those conditions.
The audit_result contains identifiable values for the planned criteria, sufficient to judge each one.
exclusion_conditions: The action probes aspects unrelated to the enumerated criteria.
The observation does not report values for the planned criteria.
No prior criteria were enumerated, so the action is exploratory rather than an audit of a plan.

registry_snapshot.name: ASSESSES_ANOMALY_AS_NON_IMPACTING
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning acknowledges that an anomaly reported in an observation is real but judges it inconsequential to the required functionality, grounding that judgment in independent evidence that the required function still succeeds.

parameters.name: assessment_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text evaluating the significance of the observed anomaly.

parameters.name: anomaly_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the anomaly, such as an unexpected process state, leftover connection state, or stray artifact.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names the observed anomaly and states explicitly that it does not affect the required behavior.
The judgment is supported by independent functional evidence, such as a successful operation exercising the same subsystem, rather than by assertion alone.
exclusion_conditions: The anomaly is dismissed without any explanation or supporting functional evidence.
The reasoning treats the anomaly as a blocking problem that must be eliminated.
The anomaly actually prevents or degrades the required functionality.

registry_snapshot.name: DECODES_ENCODED_OBSERVATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning translates low-level or encoded fields returned by an observation, such as numeric state codes, hexadecimal addresses, raw tables, or machine-oriented formats, into domain-level states, and the stated conclusion depends on that translation.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text mapping raw fields to domain-level meanings.

parameters.name: encoded_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content is in an encoded or machine-oriented form.

assertion_conditions: The observation content is not stated in plain domain terms, such as codes, hexadecimal values, or raw tabular fields.
The reasoning explicitly maps the encoded values to concrete domain states and derives its conclusion from that mapping.
exclusion_conditions: The observation already reports the state in plain semantic terms.
The reasoning restates raw content without mapping it to domain meanings.
The reasoning's conclusion does not depend on the decoded fields.

registry_snapshot.name: REINVESTIGATES_SUSPECT_RESULT
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning flags a check as inconclusive, empty, or suspicious, and the action re-examines the same underlying question using a different technique or source of evidence.

parameters.name: doubt_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing doubt about a prior or current result and the need to re-check.

parameters.name: recheck_action
parameters.description: The action that re-examines the same question by alternative means.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses doubt, inconclusiveness, or suspicion about an existing result.
The action addresses the same underlying question, using a different method, source, or tool than the earlier attempt.
exclusion_conditions: The action investigates a new question rather than the doubted result.
No doubt or inconclusiveness about an existing result is expressed.
The action simply repeats the identical probe that already produced the suspect result without changing technique.

registry_snapshot.name: RESTORES_BASELINE_STATE
registry_snapshot.definition: The action removes or reverts artifacts created during testing so the system returns to its pre-test condition, and the reasoning states that the purpose is to leave a pristine starting point for the requester's own use.

parameters.name: restore_action
parameters.description: The action deleting or reverting test-created artifacts.

parameters.name: restore_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the intent to return the system to its initial state.

assertion_conditions: The action deletes, empties, or reverts state that was produced by the agent's own testing.
The reasoning states that the goal is a clean or initial state so the requester's intended flow will work without interference.
exclusion_conditions: The action modifies state for a purpose other than reverting to the pre-test condition.
The reasoning only notes that cleanup finished without stating the pristine-state intent.
The action removes artifacts but leaves the system in a state that still blocks the requester's flow.

registry_snapshot.name: DETECTS_DATA_INCONSISTENCY
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning identifies a concrete mismatch between an expected property of data, inferred from naming, metadata, specification, or labeling, and the property actually present in the observed data.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text pointing out the discrepancy between expectation and observed content.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly contrasts an expected property of the data with the actually observed property.
The discrepancy is concrete and identifiable, such as labels or identifiers not corresponding to the source indicated by the file or resource name.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely summarizes or restates retrieved content without contrasting it against an expectation.
The reasoning expresses generic uncertainty or surprise without identifying a specific mismatch.

registry_snapshot.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUITY_BY_INVARIANT_INTERPRETATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning resolves a detected ambiguity by adopting an interpretation or formulation whose outcome is identical under every plausible reading, so the ambiguity cannot affect the final result.

parameters.name: resolution_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text evaluating interpretations and adopting the ambiguity-invariant one.

parameters.name: ambiguity_evidence
parameters.description: The observations whose content creates the ambiguity; support is collective.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates at least two plausible interpretations of the ambiguous evidence.
The reasoning argues that the same conclusion holds under each interpretation, or chooses the superset or union formulation that is safe under all of them.
The reasoning explicitly adopts that invariant interpretation as the basis for subsequent work.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning selects one interpretation arbitrarily or on stylistic grounds without showing outcome invariance.
The chosen outcome would differ depending on which interpretation is correct.
The ambiguity evidence is not referenced in the resolution reasoning.

registry_snapshot.name: SEPARATES_MANDATORY_FROM_OPTIONAL_CRITERIA
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning classifies stated requirements into mandatory constraints and optional preferences, and assigns the preferences a subordinate role such as tie-breaking, so that only the mandatory constraints govern feasibility.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text performing the classification of requirements and assigning precedence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly marks at least one requirement as mandatory or hard and at least one other as a preference, soft, or informational.
The reasoning states that preferences apply only when the mandatory constraints leave freedom, or that a preference cannot override a hard constraint.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats all stated requirements uniformly, without distinguishing mandatory from optional.
The reasoning only lists requirements without assigning them precedence.

registry_snapshot.name: SELECTS_EARLIEST_VALID_CANDIDATE_BY_ELIMINATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning systematically enumerates candidate options in a defined order and eliminates each candidate that violates any mandatory constraint, in order to select the first surviving candidate that satisfies all of them.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating candidates, eliminating violators, and naming the first surviving candidate.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning considers multiple candidate options in a defined order, such as chronological order.
For each rejected candidate, the reasoning identifies at least one mandatory constraint that it violates.
The reasoning names the first candidate that survives all constraints as the selected answer.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning considers only a single candidate without comparison.
Candidates are rejected without identifying which constraint they violate.
The selection is made without any ordering or elimination procedure.

registry_snapshot.name: VALIDATES_OUTPUT_BY_INDEPENDENT_CHECK
registry_snapshot.definition: An action executes a check procedure constructed independently of the original derivation to test an already-produced decision or output, and the resulting observation is interpreted as confirmation or refutation of that output.

parameters.name: claim_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the decision or output to be validated and/or the intent to check it.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action executing the independent check procedure against the raw inputs and the produced output.

parameters.name: check_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the check outcome from which pass or fail can be read.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states or references a decision or produced output that is to be validated.
The check action applies a procedure that re-derives or re-tests the same requirements from raw inputs rather than merely displaying the output.
The check result reports outcomes interpretable as passing or failing for that decision or output.
exclusion_conditions: The action merely re-displays the produced output without testing it against the requirements.
The result cannot be interpreted as passing or failing the decision.
No identifiable prior decision or output is being validated.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_READ_ONLY_INPUT_UNCHANGED
registry_snapshot.definition: The action inspects metadata or checksums of input artifacts that must remain unmodified, and the resulting observation reports state from which the continued integrity (non-modification) of those inputs can be confirmed.

parameters.name: inspection_action
parameters.description: The action inspecting timestamps, checksums, or directory listings of the protected input artifacts.

parameters.name: inspection_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the integrity-relevant state of those input artifacts.

assertion_conditions: The action targets input artifacts whose preservation is required and inspects integrity-relevant state such as modification times, checksums, or existence.
The observation reports that state in a form from which non-modification of the inputs can be judged.
exclusion_conditions: The action retrieves artifact content for use in computation rather than checking integrity.
The observation does not report integrity-relevant state of the inputs.
The action modifies the input artifacts instead of inspecting them.

registry_snapshot.name: IDENTIFIES_PREREQUISITE_GAP
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning recognizes that a capability, dependency, resource, or input required to accomplish the task is absent, unavailable, or insufficient, thereby establishing a prerequisite gap that must be addressed before the task can proceed.

parameters.name: gap_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying a prerequisite needed for the task and characterizing it as missing or insufficient.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names or describes a capability, dependency, resource, or input that the task requires.
The reasoning states or clearly implies that this prerequisite is currently absent, unavailable, or insufficient for the task.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only enumerates what is already available or installed without noting any deficiency.
The reasoning identifies something as missing that is unrelated to accomplishing the stated task.
The reasoning merely reports an error message without characterizing a required prerequisite as deficient.

registry_snapshot.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUITY_BY_COMMITTED_INTERPRETATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning recognizes that a task specification, term, or requirement admits more than one plausible reading and commits to one specific reading as the basis for subsequent work, without requiring that the alternative readings yield the same outcome.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that identifies the ambiguity and selects the interpretation to be followed.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning acknowledges uncertainty or multiple plausible readings of a requirement, term, or specification.
The reasoning selects one specific reading and presents it as the interpretation that subsequent work will follow.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning adopts a requirement or term without acknowledging any alternative reading.
The reasoning merely restates the task wording without choosing among possible readings.
The reasoning raises an ambiguity but leaves the interpretation unresolved for later work.

registry_snapshot.name: MAPS_UNDERSPECIFIED_TERM_TO_CONCRETE_VALUES
registry_snapshot.definition: The reasoning resolves a term in the task requirement or specification that does not literally match any value present in the target data, by using the content of reference material that enumerates or groups the corresponding concrete categories, sources, or aliases, and adopts those concrete values as the operative selection criterion.

parameters.name: mapping_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that maps the underspecified requirement term onto concrete data values.

parameters.name: documentation_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing reference material content (documentation, schema, or specification) enumerating categories, sources, or aliases.

assertion_conditions: The requirement or specification uses a term that does not literally match any value present in the data under consideration.
The observation contains reference material content that enumerates or groups the concrete categories, sources, or aliases corresponding to that term.
The reasoning uses that reference content to select the concrete values that correspond to the term and adopts them as the criterion for subsequent selection or filtering.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates the requirement term without converting it into concrete values.
The observation reports measurements or values of the target data rather than reference material enumerating categories.
The reference content does not determine which concrete values correspond to the term.
The mapping rests only on the agent's prior knowledge or guesswork without identifiable support from the observation.

accepted_predicates.name: ENUMERATES_FAILURE_HYPOTHESES
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning presents two or more distinct candidate explanations for the same observed anomaly, missing state, or unexpected result, treating them as alternatives to be investigated or distinguished rather than committing to a single explanation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating alternative explanations for the anomaly or missing state.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly presents at least two distinct candidate causes or explanations for the same anomaly, missing state, or unexpected result.
The candidates are framed as alternatives that must be investigated, distinguished, or otherwise resolved.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only one diagnosis or conclusion.
The reasoning merely reports the symptom or current state without proposing candidate causes.
The reasoning lists optional actions rather than alternative explanations.
The listed alternatives do not address the same anomaly or missing state.

accepted_predicates.name: RECONSTRUCTS_EVENT_TIMELINE
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning reconstructs an ordered chronological sequence of past events from recorded history and uses that ordering to explain how the current state or artifact configuration arose.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text reconstructing the historical sequence and its relation to the current state.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning orders at least two recorded events in time.
The reasoning explicitly relates the sequence of past events to the current repository, system, or artifact state.
The reconstruction provides temporal or causal connections among the events.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning lists historical entries without ordering or interpreting them.
The reasoning discusses only a single past event.
The reasoning reports only the current state without reconstructing how it arose.

accepted_predicates.name: DIAGNOSES_LOST_STATE_CAUSE
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning concludes a specific causal explanation for why expected content, an artifact, or a state is absent from the current view, identifying the operation or sequence that detached, discarded, hid, overwrote, or otherwise removed it.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the causal explanation for the missing content, artifact, or state.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a cause for content, an artifact, or a state being absent from the current view.
The reasoning identifies the operation or sequence of operations responsible for the loss, detachment, hiding, or overwriting.
The explanation is presented as a conclusion rather than only as an unexamined possibility.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only enumerates possible causes without selecting or supporting one.
The reasoning only reports the current location or absence of the missing content.
The reasoning identifies where an artifact is but provides no causal explanation for its absence.

accepted_predicates.name: CONSULTS_HISTORY_TO_LOCATE_LOST_ARTIFACT
accepted_predicates.definition: An action queries historical records, reflogs, audit trails, backups, or unreachable-object stores to locate an artifact or state absent from the current visible state, and the observation returns historical entries or orphaned objects identifying the missing artifact.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action querying historical records, reflogs, audit trails, backups, or unreachable-object stores.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result returning historical entries or orphaned artifacts not visible in the current state.

assertion_conditions: The action targets historical records or a recovery store rather than only the current working state.
The observation returns prior-state entries, orphaned objects, or historical references that are not present in the current visible state.
The returned information can be used to locate the missing artifact or state.
exclusion_conditions: The action inspects only current files, current references, or current status.
The observation contains no historical or unreachable-artifact information.
The historical query is unrelated to locating a missing artifact or state.

accepted_predicates.name: DISAMBIGUATES_CANDIDATES_BY_PROVENANCE
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning selects one among multiple candidate artifacts as the intended target by comparing provenance attributes reported in an observation, such as authorship, timing, origin, or parentage, and rejects or sets aside at least one alternative.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text comparing candidates and selecting the intended target.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting provenance attributes for the candidate artifacts.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports distinguishable provenance attributes for at least two candidate artifacts.
The reasoning uses at least one provenance attribute to select one candidate as the intended target.
The reasoning explicitly or implicitly rejects or sets aside at least one other candidate on the basis of the reported provenance.
exclusion_conditions: Only one candidate artifact is considered.
The selection is based solely on content similarity or arbitrary preference without provenance evidence.
The observation lacks attributes that distinguish the candidates.

accepted_predicates.name: PREDICTS_CONFLICT_FROM_OVERLAPPING_CHANGES
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning predicts, before attempting integration, that combining two versions will produce a conflict because an observation shows that both versions changed the same artifact or overlapping regions.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text predicting that integration will conflict in a particular artifact or region.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation showing changes from both versions in the same artifact or overlapping regions.

assertion_conditions: The observation identifies changes from both sides to the same artifact or overlapping regions.
The reasoning predicts that combining or merging the versions will conflict in that artifact or region before the operation is attempted.
The predicted conflict is explicitly tied to the observed overlap.
exclusion_conditions: Only one side is observed to have changed the artifact or region.
The reasoning predicts conflict without evidence of overlapping changes.
The conflict is discovered only after an integration operation is attempted rather than predicted from comparison.

accepted_predicates.name: JUSTIFIES_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_PRECEDENCE
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning chooses which side of an identified conflict should prevail and justifies that choice by a substantive criterion such as recency, authority, intended semantics, precedence, or supersession.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text choosing and justifying the side of the conflict to retain.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies conflicting versions or changes.
The reasoning selects one side to prevail.
The reasoning provides a substantive criterion explaining why the selected side supersedes the other.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes both sides without choosing one.
The reasoning selects a side without giving any substantive justification.
No conflict is identified in the reasoning.

accepted_predicates.name: VERIFIES_EXACT_CONTENT_BEFORE_REPRODUCTION
accepted_predicates.definition: An action retrieves the exact byte-level or formatting-level representation of source content that is about to be reproduced, and the observation reports those exact details so that the reproduction can preserve fidelity.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action retrieving byte-level or formatting-level details of the source content.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The result reporting exact bytes, encoding, line endings, trailing whitespace, or content length.

assertion_conditions: The action queries an exact representation of content intended for reproduction or resolution.
The observation reports byte-level or formatting-level details rather than only semantic content.
The check occurs before the source content is written, merged, or otherwise reproduced.
exclusion_conditions: The action reads only semantic content without exact-format details.
The exact-content check occurs after the content has already been written, merged, or otherwise reproduced.
The observation does not report details relevant to preserving content fidelity.

accepted_predicates.name: ELIMINATES_HYPOTHESIS_WITH_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE
accepted_predicates.definition: The reasoning rules out or deprioritizes a candidate explanation because an observation reports that an expected trace, condition, or indicator required by that explanation is absent.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text using the absence of an expected indicator to rule out or deprioritize a candidate explanation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting a clean state or the absence of an expected trace or condition.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a candidate explanation that would require a particular trace or condition to be present.
The observation reports that the required trace or condition is absent.
The reasoning concludes that the candidate explanation is unlikely or eliminated because of that absence.
exclusion_conditions: The observation confirms the presence of the expected trace rather than its absence.
The absence is merely noted without being used to eliminate or deprioritize a hypothesis.
The absent evidence is unrelated to the candidate explanation.

original_predicate.name: VERIFIES_EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR
original_predicate.definition: An action performs a check aimed at a specific behavior, output, or result that reasoning identified as expected, and the resulting observation reports an outcome matching that expectation, thereby confirming the behavior.

parameters.name: expectation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the expected behavior, output, or result.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action directed at exercising or observing the expected behavior.

parameters.name: result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the check.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a specific behavior, output, or result that is expected to occur.
The action is directed at exercising or observing that behavior or result.
The observation reports content consistent with the stated expectation, without contradiction.
exclusion_conditions: No expected behavior, output, or result is identifiable in the reasoning.
The action is unrelated to the expectation or only incidentally observes it.
The observation contradicts the expectation or is inconclusive about it.
The action only confirms existence, metadata, or an intermediate artifact state without addressing the expected behavior or result.

revised_predicate.name: VERIFIES_EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR
revised_predicate.definition: An action performs an operation or check directed at a specific behavior, output, or result that reasoning identified as expected, and the resulting observation reports an outcome matching that expectation, thereby confirming it.

parameters.name: expectation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the expected behavior, output, or result.

parameters.name: check_action
parameters.description: The action executing an operation or check capable of producing or observing the expected behavior or result.

parameters.name: result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the operation or check.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a specific behavior, output, or result that is expected to occur from an operation or check.
The action is directed at exercising, producing, or observing that behavior or result.
The observation reports content consistent with the stated expectation, without contradiction.
exclusion_conditions: No expected behavior, output, or result is identifiable in the reasoning.
The action is unrelated to the expectation or only incidentally observes it.
The observation contradicts the expectation or is inconclusive about it.
The action only confirms existence, metadata, or an intermediate artifact state without addressing the expected behavior or result.
